critical_code_review_comments: Same as previous iteration: /app/backend/server.py is ~4164 lines; admin booking endpoints (accept/confirm/reschedule/confirm-time/cancel/refund) should be extracted to an admin_bookings router (>700-line guideline).

Duplicate accept vs confirm paths still coexist (/api/admin/bookings/{id}/accept vs /confirm) — a member could receive two notifications if admin uses both on the same booking. Consider consolidating semantics.

The reschedule modal submit label is 'CONFIRM & NOTIFY' but the action now sets status=admin_proposed (awaiting member) rather than immediately confirming. Consider renaming the button to 'PROPOSE & NOTIFY' to match the new semantics and avoid admin confusion.
